items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: So I met Cannonball when I was in junior high.

ctx.x: So I met Cannonball when I was in junior high. Man he was, you know, just so down to earth. Sometimes you have these expectations of like when you think about somebody like Cannonball, like a God you know. But you meet him and he’s just as genuine as his music was. And that’s the thing that really impressed me about a lot of the musicians who I met.
